resources.string: Who is really calling, when the phone is locked.
Tap who they say they are.
Don\'t send money or share an OTP.
Caller ID may be faked. Don\'t send money or share an OTP.
Ring or call them to be sure.

During a phone or WhatsApp call, listens on this phone for what scammers say, and warns you and your family. Nothing is recorded or kept: the sound is checked as it comes and then dropped. It also sees which app you open during the call, so it can stop you paying a scammer.
CS Bank: %1$s may be on a scam call right now. Please call them and tell them to cut the call. Don\'t let them send money or share an OTP.
